steps.title: Create an app and link a Page
steps.detail: In the LinkedIn Developer Portal, create an app and associate it with a LinkedIn Page. A Page super admin must verify the app before some products become available.
steps.blockerTip: Do not skip Page verification if you need Page products. Some products stay unavailable until verification is done.

steps.title: Add products, minimum only
steps.detail: In the Products tab, add only the products you need. Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect and Share on LinkedIn are common starting products. Request Community Management only if you need Company Page posting and meet its requirements.
steps.blockerTip: Adding every product slows review. Each product has its own scopes and requirements.

steps.title: Add the exact redirect URL and copy credentials
steps.detail: In the Auth tab, copy Client ID and Client secret, and add your Authorized redirect URL. It must be https and match your code exactly.
steps.blockerTip: Never put the secret in client code or a public repo. A redirect mismatch stops the flow.

steps.title: Request only the scopes you need
steps.detail: Send the member to the authorization URL with response_type code, client_id, redirect_uri, state, and scope. For OpenID sign-in, use openid, profile, and email. For Company Pages, add w_organization_social only after Community Management is approved.
steps.blockerTip: Members must accept all requested scopes or none. Do not request scopes you do not use.

steps.title: Exchange the code quickly and test
steps.detail: Check state on callback, then exchange the code within 30 minutes at the token endpoint. Store tokens server side, then test one API call, for example userinfo for OpenID sign-in.
steps.blockerTip: Access tokens for member flows last 60 days in LinkedIn docs summaries. Refresh tokens are limited to approved partners, so plan for re-authorization.

tested: Official LinkedIn OAuth docs checked on 2026-10-31 via search results. No LinkedIn sign-in, app creation, or OAuth test was completed for this guide.
